legend.fallback: No finer data; keeping the {level} level.
legend.ec02: Real data: SII F2890, deeds {from}–{to}. All property types, no floor area.
legend.in04: Real data: DTPM GTFS, weekday 7–9 am, stops within 500 m straight line. Zones without buildings shown faint.
legend.in01: Real data: Overture Maps and DTPM GTFS. Grocery, pharmacy, primary care and transit; 100 = all within 5 min, 0 = 20+ min. Minutes estimated from straight-line distance.
legend.so01: Real data: INE Census 2024 by block. Residents per km² of each cell; for the comuna, the density the average resident lives at (empty hills don't dilute it).
legend.en03: Real data: Greater Santiago Urban Noise Map 2023 (MMA, 2024). Mean daytime Ld in the open space of blocks, excluding carriageways; 5 dB classes.
legend.hazards: Real data: MINVU RM (PRMS risk areas and hazard studies). % of residents (Census 2024) living inside the official zone. Each hazard separately; outside a polygon does not mean no risk.
legend.en04: Real data: Sentinel-2 (Copernicus), 17 January 2026, 10 m. Mean NDVI: in the dry summer only trees and irrigation stay green.
legend.climate: Real data: ARClim (MMA, CR2), historical climate 1980–2010 by comuna (~5 km model, no neighbourhood detail).
legend.rs03: Real data: INE and SPD, ENUSC 2024 small-area estimates (experimental statistics). % of households victim of a violent crime in 12 months; comuna level only.
legend.en01: Real data: SINCA (MMA), 10 stations in the Metropolitan Region, annual mean 2023–2025. Comuna value interpolated from stations: a coarse surface.

drawer.label: Selected place card
drawer.demoNote: Sale prices, transit and daily services are real data; other values in this build are synthetic. Comuna geometries are real.
drawer.teaserTitle: The information. And what it means.
drawer.teaserText: Estimated value, records, surroundings and priority checks in a single report.
drawer.method_EC02: SII form F2890 (registered transfers). Sales from 500 to 100,000 UF; a deal covering several rols (apartment + parking + storage) counts once. No type or floor area until the SII catastro is joined.
drawer.method_IN04: DTPM GTFS (Red Metropolitana de Movilidad). Weekday 7–9 am departures per hour at stops and stations within 500 m straight line of the zone center; not walking time over streets. Comuna: zone average weighted by building count (Overture).
drawer.accNote: Estimated minutes: straight line ×1.3 at 4.5 km/h, not an actual route.
drawer.method_IN01: Overture Maps (places with confidence ≥0.5) and DTPM GTFS stops. Four equally weighted groups: grocery, pharmacy, primary care, transit; score 100 at ≤5 min, 0 at ≥20 min. Minutes estimated from straight-line distance ×1.3 at 4.5 km/h. Measures distance, not service quality.
drawer.method_SO01: INE Census 2024 block cartography (n_per). Each block is assigned to the ~600 m cell containing its center; gross density = residents / cell area. Comuna value: population-weighted mean of cell densities. Cells without residents have no value.
drawer.method_EN03: MMA Greater Santiago Urban Noise Map 2023 (published April 2024). The day map (Ld) is published as colored tiles; we decode each ~30 m pixel to its 5 dB class and average pixels below 75 dBA within the cell (carriageways are drawn above 75, buildings have no value). Comuna: population-weighted mean (Census 2024). Official exposure by comuna (residents above 65 dBA day, 55 dBA night) is shown in the card.
drawer.noiseExposure: Official MMA: {day}% of residents above 65 dBA by day, {night}% above 55 dBA at night.
drawer.method_RS07: MINVU SEREMI/SERVIU RM, OTRAS_AMENAZAS_RMS service. Flooding: PRMS recurrently floodable areas and groundwater outcrop, high flood zone, river floods and hyperconcentrated flows. Mass movement: PRMS landslide and collapse areas, high-hazard debris flows. Seismic: soils with very poor seismic response. Value: % of Census 2024 residents (block centers) inside the area; hazards are not summed. Metropolitan source scale: not a substitute for a site study.
drawer.method_RS09: MINVU SEREMI/SERVIU RM, OTRAS_AMENAZAS_RMS service. Flooding: PRMS recurrently floodable areas and groundwater outcrop, high flood zone, river floods and hyperconcentrated flows. Mass movement: PRMS landslide and collapse areas, high-hazard debris flows. Seismic: soils with very poor seismic response. Value: % of Census 2024 residents (block centers) inside the area; hazards are not summed. Metropolitan source scale: not a substitute for a site study.
drawer.method_RS05: MINVU SEREMI/SERVIU RM, OTRAS_AMENAZAS_RMS service. Flooding: PRMS recurrently floodable areas and groundwater outcrop, high flood zone, river floods and hyperconcentrated flows. Mass movement: PRMS landslide and collapse areas, high-hazard debris flows. Seismic: soils with very poor seismic response. Value: % of Census 2024 residents (block centers) inside the area; hazards are not summed. Metropolitan source scale: not a substitute for a site study.
drawer.faultKm: Distance to the San Ramón fault (MINVU trace): {km} km.
drawer.method_EN04: Sentinel-2 L2A (Copernicus, ESA), cloud-free scene of 2026-01-17, tiles 19HCD and 19HCC via Element84 COGs on AWS. NDVI = (B8 − B4)/(B8 + B4) at 10 m; clouds, shadows and water removed using the SCL band. Cell: mean of its pixels. Comuna: Census 2024 population-weighted mean. One summer date: measures green cover, not park quality.
drawer.method_CL01: ARClim (Ministry of Environment, CR2), comunas layer: days per year with maximum above 30 °C, historical period 1980–2010. The card shows the projected change to 2035–2065 under SSP2-4.5 (model mean). Source resolution ~5 km: comuna level only.
drawer.method_CL03: ARClim (MMA, CR2), comunas layer: annual accumulated precipitation, historical period 1980–2010. The card shows the projected change to 2035–2065 under SSP2-4.5. The post-2010 megadrought is not in the historical mean.
drawer.method_RS03: INE and Undersecretariat for Crime Prevention: comuna SAE estimates of the ENUSC 2024 VHDV indicator (experimental statistics) with 95% confidence interval. Measures households victim of robbery with violence or intimidation, snatching and assault. Not downscaled to neighbourhoods.
drawer.method_EN01: SINCA (Ministry of Environment): daily validated (or preliminary) PM2.5 from 10 Metropolitan Region stations, 2023–2025; years with ≥75% of days. Comuna value: inverse-distance-squared interpolation to the comuna's population centre. With few stations this is coarse; the card shows the nearest station. Chilean annual standard: 20 µg/m³.
drawer.airStation: Nearest station: {st}, {v} µg/m³ measured, {km} km away.

partners.title: Context for your users. Information for their decisions.

partners.agenciesText: Report packs, batch requests and client delivery from one workspace.

methods.title: Clear data. Clear conclusions.
methods.lead: Every indicator keeps its source, date, scale and status: observed, documented or estimated.
methods.aText: Available detail varies by place and indicator. A comuna-level figure keeps that scope on a property card.
methods.bText: Estimates come with their method and limits. Missing information stays visible.
methods.cText: The report brings together evidence, calculations and analysis. Checks that need documents or a visit are marked explicitly.
methods.dText: Each source's date accompanies the indicator. Historical versions are kept apart from current observations.

object.pointOnly: Address point; the building is not identified. Zoom in and tap the building to refine.
object.identityNote: The footprint is not the legal parcel boundary and does not identify an apartment.
object.unknown: Not established in the free card
object.walkNote: Estimated minutes: straight line ×1.3 at 4.5 km/h, not a real route. Places from Overture Maps and DTPM GTFS stops.

obs.transitFar: Metro more than ~{min} min away and no nearby stop.
obs.dailyNear: Grocery, pharmacy and health care within {min} min on foot.
obs.dailyFar: Some daily service is more than ~{min} min on foot.
obs.quiet: Moderate daytime noise in the zone (~{db} dBA Ld).
obs.noisy: High traffic noise in the zone (~{db} dBA Ld).
obs.flood: The point lies inside an official flood area (MINVU/PRMS).
obs.landslide: The point lies inside an official landslide or collapse area.
obs.seismicSoil: Very poor seismic soil response per the MINVU study.
obs.fault: ~{km} km from the San Ramón fault trace.
obs.victimHigh: Violent crime victimization {pct}% in {comuna} (whole comuna, not the street).
obs.unit: Which apartment or unit, floor area and floor.
obs.objectPrice: Price of this object (only the comuna median is available).
obs.condition: Condition of the building and unit.

report.title: Full object card
report.fault: Distance to the San Ramón fault
report.hazardNote: Official MINVU areas at metropolitan scale. Being outside a polygon does not guarantee no risk; not a substitute for a site study.
report.priceText: Median {median} UF in {comuna} (interquartile range {p25}–{p75} UF), {n} sales in 24 months, all property types.
report.priceNote: Source SII F2890. This is comuna context, not this object's value: without floor area and type no UF/m² is computed.
report.noFlags: No notable observations with the available data.
report.paidAdds: The paid report adds identification of the unit and its rol, available documents, price comparables, scenarios and an explanation of all of the above.
report.disclaimer: Card generated automatically by fixed rules from public sources; each figure states its scale. Not a valuation, title search or engineering survey.
